text.en:
The unexpended balance of the appropriation made in Act Numbered Thirty-seven hundred and
eighteen, entitled "An Act appropriating the sum of one hundred thousand pesos for the payment of the
compensation of tax specialists and other expenses incidental to the revision of the systems of taxation
including the tariff, and for other purposes," which was made available by the general appropriation Act for
the year nineteen hundred and thirty-two for the expenses of the Committee on Taxation created by the Ninth
Philippine Legislature is also hereby made available in the sum not to exceed twenty-five thousand pesos for
the expenses of the Committee on National Economy, with the approval of the presiding officers of both
Houses, in accordance with the provisions of Concurrent Resolution Numbered Nine adopted on November
seventh, nineteen hundred and thirty-one, including salaries of the personnel and other incidental expenses for
the years nineteen hundred and thirty-one and nineteen hundred and thirty-two which may be necessary for
the proper compliance of the purposes set forth in said Regulation.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
